===== HEAD README 1-54 =====
     1	# Crazy Putt Arena
     2	
     3	Crazy Putt Arena is an original browser-based arcade mini-golf game built with TypeScript, Three.js and Rapier 3D. One human player competes against configurable bot opponents across a sequence of themed holes: aim with the mouse, charge the shot with the power meter, and let arcade-tuned ball physics do the rest. Ten courses of nine holes each mix ramps, bumpers, conveyors, fans, teleporters and hazard zones, and every match ends with a scoreboard, rating update and progression rewards.
     4	
     5	## Requirements
     6	
     7	- Node.js 20 or newer
     8	- A modern desktop browser with WebGL 2 (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari)
     9	
    10	## Install
    11	
    12	```bash
    13	npm install
    14	```
    15	
    16	## Run
    17	
    18	```bash
    19	npm run dev
    20	```
    21	
    22	Vite prints a local URL (http://localhost:5173 by default); open it in the browser.
    23	
    24	## Build
    25	
    26	```bash
    27	npm run build
    28	```
    29	
    30	The production build type-checks the project first and then emits the bundle into `dist/`.
    31	
    32	## Typecheck
    33	
    34	```bash
    35	npm run typecheck
    36	```
    37	
    38	## Test
    39	
    40	```bash
    41	npm test
    42	```
    43	
    44	`npm test` runs the whole Vitest suite: the colocated unit tests under `src/**` and the
    45	cross-module integration tests under `tests/**`. Focused subsets:
    46	
    47	```bash
    48	npm run test:ui      # UI layer (src/ui)
    49	npm run test:input   # input and developer tools (src/input, src/dev)
    50	npm run test:camera  # camera system (src/camera)
    51	npm run test:watch   # re-run affected tests on change
    52	```
    53	
    54	## Project structure

tests/leaderboard-generator.test.ts

===== package.json scripts =====
{
  "name": "crazy-putt-arena",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "tsc -b && vite build",
    "typecheck": "tsc -b --pretty false",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "test:ui": "vitest run src/ui",
    "test:input": "vitest run src/input src/dev",
    "test:camera": "vitest run src/camera"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@dimforge/rapier3d-compat": "^0.17.3",

}
